title: Emotions
caption:
The hardest part of trading usually isn't reading the chart. It's managing yourself.

Fear makes you sell the bottom. FOMO makes you buy the top. And after a loss, the urge to win it back fast leads to bigger, worse trades.

Decide your exits before you enter. On Meme Street you can set a take-profit and stop-loss with a one-click bracket, learn the psychology in the lessons, and feel your first losses with practice money.

Practise the mental side at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.
